Workflow overview and setup

parameters.content:
## Create standard and scaled workout videos

### How it works
For gyms and coaches: turn today’s approved training plan into standard and optional scaled videos using the exercises the coach supplies. Keep separate video URLs and captions for each version, and skip completed versions. Both paths validate the credit quote, save accepted render IDs, resume interrupted jobs and record outcomes in Google Sheets. Review completed media before sharing manually.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`; select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect every Google Sheets node to the same document and tab. Add the input and tracking headers from the [setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/workout-of-the-day.md).
4. Supply unique WorkoutKey, Date (YYYY-MM-DD), WorkoutName and Ex1; set Approval=approved after coach review.
5. Set branding, timezone and maxCreditsPerVideo. **dryRun=false spends credits.** true returns validation, quote and design JSON only; no editor draft.
6. Test manually, inspect the saved results, then enable the schedule. Avoid overlapping runs. Keep job IDs when investigating failures.

### Customization
Fill ScaledEx1–ScaledEx5 for the optional scaled version; fallbackToLatest preserves the selected workout’s date.

nodes.name: 1. Set the brand and run schedule

parameters.content:
## 1. Set the brand and run schedule

Set gym branding, timezone, media, polling deadline and maxCreditsPerVideo. At most two coach-approved versions are selected for the chosen date.

nodes.name: 2. Choose coach-approved workout versions

parameters.content:
## 2. Choose coach-approved workout versions

Require one date per plan, unique WorkoutKey, Approval=approved and Ex1. Optional ScaledEx1–ScaledEx5 are coach-written alternatives. Preserve original dates when fallbackToLatest is enabled.

nodes.name: 4. Build one video or resume its saved job

parameters.content:
## 4. Build one video or resume its saved job

Each item is processed sequentially. Existing job IDs resume polling without submitting another paid render.

nodes.name: 5. Validate the design and enforce the credit cap

parameters.content:
## 5. Validate the design and enforce the credit cap

Stop when validation fails or the quote exceeds maxCreditsPerVideo. dryRun=true returns the quote, caption and design JSON without saving an editor draft.

nodes.name: 6. Record a pending submission before rendering

parameters.content:
## 6. Record a pending submission before rendering

Write submitting before the paid request. An interrupted or uncertain submission stays blocked for inspection. Run only one execution at a time; Sheets updates are not atomic locks.

nodes.name: 7. Save the accepted job for recovery

parameters.content:
## 7. Save the accepted job for recovery

Persist the accepted job ID before polling. On later runs, saved jobs are resumed without paying for another submission.

nodes.name: 8. Poll until completion failure or timeout

parameters.content:
## 8. Poll until completion failure or timeout

Each video gets its own polling deadline. Failed, timed-out and unknown outcomes retain the job ID for inspection and deliberate recovery.

nodes.name: 9. Write the video result and ready-to-share caption

parameters.content:
## 9. Write the video result and ready-to-share caption

Add tracking headers: StandardStatus, StandardJobId, StandardCredits, StandardVideoUrl, StandardCaption, StandardRenderedAt, ScaledStatus, ScaledJobId, ScaledCredits, ScaledVideoUrl, ScaledCaption, ScaledRenderedAt. Updates match WorkoutKey and preserve the other version’s fields.

nodes.name: 3. Process one version and collect the batch

parameters.content:
## 3. Process one version and collect the batch

The loop submits one version at a time. The completed-item return runs below the main stages. The done output summarizes standard and scaled results and skipped reasons.

nodes.name: 10. Review saved results and completed videos

parameters.content:
## 10. Review saved results and completed videos

Each version keeps its own tracking fields and caption. Open Watch video → Binary → data → View and select the output item. Sharing is manual.
